read.title: Comments on the Supply Agreement
read.text:
Dear Mr. Harris,

Thank you for sending the draft supply agreement. Our team has reviewed it, and overall the terms look fair. However, there are two points I'd like to clarify.

First, Clause 5 says that prices may change with 30 days' notice. Could we revisit this and extend the notice period to 90 days? This would give us time to plan our budget.

Second, the contract does not mention what happens if a shipment is late. We suggest adding a clause that is mutually agreeable to both sides.

Once these points are settled, our CEO will sign off on the final version.

Best regards,
Minsu Kim
qs: Minsu가 가격 변경 통지 기간을 얼마로 늘리자고 했나요?

write.task: 거래처에서 받은 계약서 초안에서 계약 기간(1년)을 2년으로 바꾸고 싶어요. 초안에 감사하고, 기간을 다시 논의하자는 짧은 이메일을 써 보세요.
write.en: Write a short email thanking a partner for the draft contract and asking to discuss changing the term from one year to two.
write.model:
Dear Ms. Lee,

Thank you for the draft contract. Overall, the terms look good to us. However, could we revisit the contract period? We would prefer two years instead of one, as it would help us plan long-term orders. If you agree, our director can sign off on it this week.

Best regards,
Minsu
